freshCityLocalSearch.summary: Ordinary-host requests with TLS verification enabled succeeded (HTTP 200) against public ArcGIS Online. Metadata confirms Lagos_Charting__WFL1 layer 2 lagosplanPolygon is polygon geometry with fields PLN, LOTAINF, LOTAAC, LOTASF, LOTDES, UP, but no service description or copyright. A bounded 0.002-degree WGS84 bbox at the WUP point returned count=2 and two polygons. All six lot/plan fields were null in both; the two 93-vertex geometries are exactly equal (same SHA-256) and span approximately 3.7 km by 6.9 km, rather than separate parcel boundaries. ArcGIS OBJECTIDs 86987/86993 are transport row IDs only. Related Lagos_CPs layer is points explicitly named community pharmacies; Lagos_Survey_X_FeaturesToJSO1 is school flood survey points. Thus this route exposes public target-intersecting polygon geometry but does not verify parcel boundaries or a native parcel key. Earlier web fetcher cache-miss and restricted-shell DNS failures were environment/tool limitations, not upstream status. A second bounded query with an OR-of-IS-NOT-NULL filter across all six plausible lot/plan fields (±0.02° bbox, about 4.4 km square) returned count=0 and no sample at HTTP 200. The layer advertises a large Web Mercator extent and maxRecordCount 2000. This is a limited target-neighborhood result only, not a citywide absence claim.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City-level only; no broader coverage implied.

blocker: No meaningful native lot attributes were returned around the target. At the exact target, two identical large polygons had null lot/plan fields; within the approximately 4.4 km local envelope, the OR-of-non-null-fields filter matched zero rows. OBJECTIDs remain transport identifiers only.
remainingUncertainty: The layer advertises a broad extent across multiple countries and this bounded local check does not establish Lagos-wide coverage or absence. Official/restricted cadastral datasets may exist outside this layer.
nextStep: Only revisit if a documented official Lagos parcel layer or viewer route yields parcel-scale geometry and non-null stable parcel keys; do not infer identity from this layer’s OBJECTID.
